products.title: Full Decoration Package – Tier 1
products.content:
Take the stress out of doing it yourself and let IncaBella decorate all three floors of the Mill.

Ground floor

  • The river window display
  • Your choice of post box
  • Lots of lanterns, tealights, crates and potted flowers

Ceremony room

  • Each corner of the stage: a large white wooden lantern on a crate, with at least five tall glass vases or hurricane lanterns, all with candles and fresh greenery
  • Down the aisle: a Mohani lantern or large glass hurricane lamp on a log slice at the end of every other row
  • Prefer an outdoor ceremony? Add £50

Tables

  • Lucy moves your aisle ends up to become your table centre pieces, with a table number frame and tealights on each table
  • Based on 8–10 round tables, or 8 round tables and a top table two tables long

Optional extras at additional cost: greenery garlands, chair sashes, fairy lights, garden games, the firepit, extra flowers, bouquets and buttonholes.

products.title: Full Decoration Package – Tier 2
products.content:
Everything in Tier 1, plus fairy lights, chair sashes and a greenery runner. IncaBella decorates all three floors of the Mill.

Ground floor

  • The river window display
  • Your choice of post box
  • Lots of lanterns, tealights, crates and potted flowers

Ceremony room

  • Each corner of the stage: a large white wooden lantern on a crate, with at least five tall glass vases or hurricane lanterns, all with candles and fresh greenery
  • Down the aisle: a Mohani lantern or large glass hurricane lamp on a log slice at the end of every other row, and a white sash on each aisle-end chair
  • A net of fairy lights along the back wall and fairy lights zig-zagged across the ceiling

Tables

  • Lucy moves your aisle ends up to become your table centre pieces, with a table number frame and tealights on each table
  • A greenery runner along the top table
  • Based on 8–10 round tables, or 8 round tables and a top table two tables long

Optional extras at additional cost: greenery garlands, aisle runner, wooden arch, garden games, the firepit, extra flowers, bouquets and buttonholes.

products.title: Ground Floor Decoration Package
products.content:
Let IncaBella make the ground floor of Sopley Mill look wonderful.

  • The river window display (usually £95 on its own)
  • Your choice of post box, set up with flowers and tealights
  • The large heart light
  • A Moroccan lantern
  • Lots more lanterns and tealights
  • Potted flowers and small potted trees such as olives

Set up on the morning of your wedding. Talk to Lucy about which flowers will be in season for your date, or about any colour scheme you have in mind.

products.title: Outdoor Ceremony Set-Up
products.content:
A beautiful, rustic dressing for an outdoor ceremony.

  • Each corner by the signing table decorated with crates, cut logs, lanterns and potted flowers
  • A mix of potted flowers and lanterns at each bench end down the aisle
  • Two large potted olive trees

Add the wooden arch with billowing white fabric for £165.

Set up on the morning of your wedding and tailored to you, for example swapping one lantern style for another. Exact potted flowers depend on what's growing at the time.

Once it's set up outside it can't be moved in if the weather changes. Lucy can set it up inside instead if you let her know by the evening before.

products.title: Ceremony Room Set-Up
products.content:
A beautiful, rustic way to make the ceremony room look and smell lovely.

  • Each corner of the stage: a large white wooden lantern on a crate, with at least five tall glass vases or hurricane lanterns, all with candles
  • Down the aisle: a Mohani lantern or large glass hurricane lamp on a log slice at the end of every other row

Add-ons

  • Lots of fresh greenery: £80
  • Two small milk churns with flower arrangements: £135
  • Ivory chair sashes, 20 for £50
  • Fairy lights, aisle runners and extra flowers: ask Lucy for prices

Set up on the morning of your wedding and tailored to you, for example swapping one lantern style for another.

products.title: River Window Set-Up
products.content:
Let IncaBella dress the alcove in the Mill's river window.

  • Seasonal potted plants and an olive tree
  • Crates and small LOVE letters
  • A large selection of tealights and lanterns

Set up on the morning of your wedding. Talk to Lucy about which flowers will be in season for your date, or about any colour scheme you have in mind.

products.title: Apple Crate Set-Up
products.content:
A lovely welcome as your guests arrive.

  • Five vintage apple crates
  • A selection of lanterns and tealights
  • Potted flowers, plants and small posies
  • Set up outside or in

Set up on the morning of your wedding. Talk to Lucy about which flowers will be in season for your date, or about any colour scheme you have in mind.

products.title: Mohani Lantern Table Centre Piece
products.content:
A table centre piece that fills the room with warmth.

  • An antique brass Mohani lantern with candle on a rustic wood slice
  • Fresh greenery
  • Five diamond glass tealights
  • A table number holder and card

Add three small vases of flowers for £15 per table. The lanterns and wood slices can also start the day as aisle ends and move up to the tables, for a small extra cost.

products.title: Glass Cylinder Table Centre Piece
products.content:
An elegant centre piece that works just as well as an aisle end.

  • Three glass cylinder vases of different heights, with pillar candles or floating candles
  • Fresh greenery
  • A table name or number frame

On the top table these look lovely set along the front edge. Real or LED candles are both options. The vases can start the day as aisle ends and move up to the tables, for a small extra cost. Chair drapes and other extras are also available.

products.title: Long Table Centre Piece
products.content:
Made for rustic long tables.

  • A greenery runner down the middle of the table
  • Tall clear glass lanterns and tealights along it

products.title: Ceiling Fairy Lights – Ceremony Room
products.content:
Warm white fairy lights zig-zagged across the ceremony room ceiling for a soft, romantic glow.

Add the fairy light wall net on the back wall for an extra £100.

products.title: Fairy Light Wall Net – Ceremony Room
products.content:
The back wall of the ceremony room covered in warm white fairy lights for a soft, romantic glow.

Add the zig-zag ceiling lights for an extra £100.

products.title: Stairwell Fairy Light Globes
products.content:
Six glowing globes hanging down the Mill's stairwell.

  • 40cm diameter, 240 warm white LEDs each
  • Price includes installation
  • Single globes for elsewhere in the Mill: £20 each

products.title: LOVE Light-Up Letters
products.content:
Aluminium LOVE letters with built-in twinkly lights.

  • Each letter about 25cm high and 21cm wide
  • Battery powered, batteries included
  • Lovely on a windowsill or the top table, or cascading down the step ladder
  • £15 when hired with a garden games package
  • Two sets available

products.title: Large Heart Light
products.content:
A handmade steel heart light that looks stunning day or night.

  • Indoor use only; needs a plug
  • Included in the Ground Floor Decoration Package
  • One available

products.title: Firepit
products.content:
A sculptural firepit ball with an African safari scene hand-cut around it that comes alive when lit. At almost a metre across, it adds drama and warmth outside the Mill and draws guests together.

  • Hire is for the whole of your wedding or event
  • Firewood not included

products.title: Hay Bales
products.content:
Extra outdoor seating at just the right height. Use them as they are for a natural country look, dress them with fabric and cushions, use them at outdoor tables, or stack them into a hay sofa.

Bales go out on the lawn on the morning of your wedding and can stay out overnight. They're cleared away the next morning.

  • Blankets: 5 for £25 or 10 for £50 (ask Lucy which colours are available)
  • Hay Bale Package, £160: 10 bales, blankets, 2 cushions, a table, 2 pots of seasonal flowers and 2 lanterns, set up as hay bale furniture

products.title: Large Potted Olive Tree
products.content:
A large olive tree for inside or out. Lovely at the end of the aisle.

  • Displayed in a large dark grey pot
  • £60 for the pair; two available

products.title: Medium Potted Olive Tree
products.content:
A medium olive tree in a vintage zinc bucket, for inside or out.

  • £30 for the pair; two available

products.title: All Eight Garden Games
products.content:
The full set of giant garden games.

  • Giant chess or giant cornhole (£150 for both)
  • Giant Jenga
  • Giant Connect 4
  • Giant noughts and crosses
  • Giant dominoes
  • Giant pick-up sticks
  • Limbo
  • Quoits

Lucy sets the games out at the Mill and collects them early in the evening, usually during the wedding breakfast. Cancel up to 24 hours before for a full refund, so you can wait and see the weather forecast.

products.title: Four Garden Games with Giant Chess
products.content:
Giant chess plus three more games of your choice: giant Jenga, giant Connect 4, giant noughts and crosses, giant dominoes, giant pick-up sticks, limbo or quoits.

  • Delivery and set-up at Sopley Mill included
  • Can be hired for other venues if collected from and returned to the Mill, the day before and after where possible

products.title: Four Garden Games
products.content:
Any four games except giant chess: giant Jenga, giant Connect 4, giant noughts and crosses, giant dominoes, giant pick-up sticks, limbo or quoits.

  • Delivery and set-up at Sopley Mill included
  • Can be hired for other venues if collected from and returned to the Mill, the day before and after where possible

products.title: Giant Cornhole
products.content:
An easy, fun game for all ages. Also included in some garden games sets.

  • Two regulation boards, 120 × 60cm, with a 6-inch hole
  • Eight professional cornhole bags

products.title: Kids' Play Tent
products.content:
A den for little guests, inside or out. Fits three small children easily, and more at a squash.

  • Built-in base, ties and a window with a flap
  • Two for £50 (the second has a different pattern)

products.title: Wooden Arch
products.content:
A rustic wooden arch dressed with ivory or white fabric. Beautiful for outdoor ceremonies and can be used inside too.

  • Add fresh greenery for £75
  • Flowers can be added at additional cost

products.title: Cast Iron Red Post Box
products.content:
A cast iron ER Royal Mail pillar box: a stylish, secure home for cards and gifts.

  • Comes with display card and key
  • £35 when booked with any other IncaBella hire
  • One available

products.title: Wooden Post Box
products.content:
A rustic wood and metal post box for cards and gifts. Lovely on a table surrounded by tealights and lanterns.

  • One available

products.title: Large Vintage Milk Churn
products.content:
A 10-gallon aluminium milk churn. Stunning with a large floral display, at the end of the aisle or either side of a door.

  • Fill with flowering branches for a less expensive option
  • £45 for two; two available

products.title: Medium Vintage Milk Churn
products.content:
An aluminium milk churn about 50cm tall. Lovely with flowers at the end of the aisle or either side of a door.

  • Lucy can add a flower display for an extra charge, or fill it yourself with flowering branches
  • £35 for two; two available

products.title: Small Vintage Milk Churn
products.content:
A small milk churn for flowers or potted plants, either side of a door or the aisle.

  • £25 for two; two available
  • With a flower arrangement: £80 each or £150 for two

products.title: Vintage Apple Crates
products.content:
Wooden crates in mixed sizes. Ideal for displaying potted flowers and lanterns, or as side tables with hay bales.

  • Five available, large and small

products.title: Two Vintage Suitcases
products.content:
Two dark tan vintage suitcases. Use them as a quirky table or instead of a post box.

  • One suitcase: £10
  • Suitcases and trunk together: £30
  • Also part of the Hay Bale Package

products.title: Vintage Trunk
products.content:
A large vintage trunk to use as a quirky table.

  • Trunk and two suitcases together: £30
  • Also part of the Hay Bale Package
  • One available

products.title: Wooden Display Step Ladder
products.content:
A wooden step ladder painted in Farrow & Ball, for inside or out. Great for displaying flowers, tealights or cupcakes.

  • One available

products.title: Rustic Display Blackboard
products.content:
A hinged, double-sided blackboard in a vintage khaki-green wooden frame.

  • 98cm high, 46cm wide
  • One available

products.title: Country Bunting
products.content:
25 metres of cotton English country bunting in checks and stripes on a white line. Lovely strung between the trees across the lawn.

  • 84 double-sided flags, each 19 × 20cm

products.title: Antique Brass Table Numbers
products.content:
Ten antique brass picture frames with printed inserts: numbers 1–9 and Top Table, or 1–10.

  • Personalised table names available at extra cost
  • Or print your own at 7 × 5 inches

products.title: Log Slices
products.content:
Rustic wooden log slices in various sizes, each one slightly different. Ask to see them.

  • 10 large and 10 small slices: £45

products.title: Round Mirror Plate
products.content:
A 40cm bevelled round mirror plate. A lovely base for vases, flowers and tealights in the centre of each table.

  • 10 for £25; ten available

products.title: Vintage Sweet Jars
products.content:
Glass sweet jars, 30cm tall. Fill each with a different sweet and make your own sweet cart.

  • 4 for £15; eight available

products.title: Tall Glass Dinner Candle Holder
products.content:
Tall, elegant dinner candles in an enclosed glass holder, safe for indoor use. Especially lovely along long tables.

  • 30cm tall, 7cm across
  • Ivory dinner candle included
  • The glass gets very hot after a while, so keep out of reach of children
  • Packages also available

products.title: Rustic Brass Votive
products.content:
A lattice-effect brass votive, 9.5 × 7.5cm, with tealight.

products.title: Sana Storm Lantern
products.content:
A grey steel and glass storm lantern, 25 × 15 × 15cm. The enclosed candle means it works inside and out: down the aisle, on tables, or along a terrace or bridge.

  • Pillar candle included (may be part-used, with plenty of burn time left)
  • 6 for £40, 8 for £50; eight available

products.title: Swedish Lantern
products.content:
An antique grey metal lantern, 15 × 37cm. The enclosed flame means it's safe indoors.

  • Pillar candle included (may be part-used, with plenty of burn time left)
  • Two available

products.title: Silver Lantern
products.content:
A quality silver lantern, 42 × 15 × 16cm, that gives off a soft, flickering light. Stunning down the aisle, along a bridge or around the terrace on a summer evening.

  • Pillar candle included (may be part-used, with plenty of burn time left)
  • 6 for £45, 8 for £55; eight available

products.title: Outdoor LED Hurricane Lantern
products.content:
A battery-powered antique grey metal lantern, 19 × 15.5 × 30cm. Lovely on tables, lining a path or hung up.

  • Batteries included
  • 10 for £50; twelve available

products.title: Large White-Washed Lantern
products.content:
A large white-washed wooden lantern, about 80cm tall. Perfect framing a doorway or the start of the aisle.

  • Pillar candle included (may be part-used, with plenty of burn time left)
  • Also part of the Ceremony Room Set-Up
  • 2 for £30; two available

products.title: Rope Lantern
products.content:
A glass lantern with a rope handle, 25 × 18cm. Lovely either side of the entrance, inside or out.

  • 2 for £15; two available

products.title: Gold Rim Tealight Holder
products.content:
A glass tealight holder with a gold rim, 7 × 6cm. Elegant dotted along every table.

  • Tealight included
  • 40 for £45; forty available

products.title: Hanging Tealight Holder
products.content:
Pretty tealight holders with little bells around the rim, made for hanging in trees. Each 6 × 8cm.

  • Tealights not included
  • 20 for £10.50; twenty available

products.title: Passu Hanging Tealight Holder
products.content:
Distressed white hanging tealight holders, 11cm high, that give a beautifully twinkly light in the trees.

  • Takes a standard tealight
  • Sixteen available

products.title: Clear Glass Hurricane Vase
products.content:
A 27 × 16.5cm hurricane vase with a pillar candle. Use to line the aisle or as a table centre piece, perhaps with pinecones or dried roses around the base.

  • Candle included (may be part-used)
  • 8 for £45, 10 for £55; ten available

products.title: Moroccan Lantern
products.content:
An antique-finish Moroccan lantern with pale blue markings, about 58cm tall. Beautiful against the Mill's red brick.

  • Pillar candle included (may be part-used, with plenty of burn time left)
  • Two available

products.title: Tall Cylinder Glass Vase
products.content:
Tall glass vases in various heights, with candles, floating candles or fairy lights inside. Lovely lining the aisle or on tables.

  • Price depends on size
  • Also part of the table centre piece and ceremony room packages

products.title: Ndiki Lantern
products.content:
A tall antique brass lantern, 41 × 20 × 20cm. The enclosed flame means it's safe indoors.

  • Pillar candle included (may be part-used, with plenty of burn time left)
  • Two available

products.title: Sparkling Silver Tealight – Small
products.content:
A rustic silver glass tealight holder with a flower pattern that really sparkles. 7cm high; mix and match with the large ones.

  • Tealights included
  • 20 for £18.50, 40 for £35
  • 20 small and 20 large together: £40

products.title: Extra Large Silver Lantern
products.content:
A very large silver lantern, 59cm tall, with three pillar candles. Perfect framing a doorway or the start of the aisle, perhaps with rose petals around the base.

  • Candles included (may be part-used, with plenty of burn time left)
  • 2 for £30; two available

products.title: Hanging Heart Tealight Holder
products.content:
Heart-shaped tealight holders for hanging in trees. Each 6 × 8cm.

  • Tealights not included
  • 20 for £10.50; twenty available

products.title: Mohani Lantern
products.content:
An asymmetric antique brass lantern, 26 × 16cm. A lovely table centre piece, and stunning lining the aisle or dotted around the terrace on a summer evening.

  • Pillar candle included (may be part-used, with plenty of burn time left)
  • 10 for £95; twelve available

products.title: Sparkling Silver Tealight – Large
products.content:
A rustic silver glass tealight holder with a flower pattern that really sparkles. 9cm high; mix and match with the small ones.

  • Tealights included
  • 10 for £15, 20 for £25, 40 for £40
  • 20 small and 20 large together: £40
